old_caption: The video shows a static arrangement of colorful dominoes on a wooden floor. The dominoes, in various bright colors including red, yellow, blue, green, and purple, are set up in a complex, winding pattern with some sections elevated on small supports. No motion or falling occurs in the visible sequence. The wooden floor provides a light-colored, neutral background that contrasts with the vibrant colors of the dominoes. The scene remains unchanged throughout the clip.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a dynamic scene on a wooden floor where a series of colorful dominoes are arranged in a complex pattern. The dominoes, in various bright colors such as red, yellow, blue, green, and purple, are set up to form a zigzag path across the floor. As the video progresses, the dominoes begin to fall in a chain reaction, starting from one end and moving towards the other. Each domino knocks over the next, creating a cascading effect that travels along the zigzag path. The sequence captures the fluid motion of the dominoes as they tumble, highlighting the precision and timing required for such an intricate setup. The wooden floor beneath provides a neutral background that contrasts with the vibrant colors of the dominoes, making their movement stand out vividly. The video ends with the dominoes continuing their fall until the entire structure is toppled, leaving a trail of fallen pieces across the floor.
caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a wooden floor covered with an elaborate network of colorful rectangular blocks arranged in chains, several of which rest on small white-and-brown elevated stands while others lie flat on the planks. A domino cascade is already underway, propagating through the chains one after another rather than all at once. The curved loop at the lower right flattens as its magenta and orange end blocks topple to lie flat. The orange and yellow blocks at the right end of the top-middle chain fall over, and a toppling wave then runs through the upper-left diagonal pink-and-red chain, leaving it flattened. The magenta block at the right end of the bottom-left elevated chain tips down. A block near the left end of the top-left cluster tilts as the right-middle chain's orange block falls. Throughout, the far-right zigzag chain, the leftmost floor chain, the central vertical blue chain, and all the stands themselves remain upright and in place.
